title: Lantern parade
brief: The original delivery of ten bundles of reusable lantern frames to assembly hall has fallen through. The parade committee needs a replacement shipment in time for the makers' afternoon session. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text: I can release all ten bundles at 09:15 at the earliest. They’re packed and must travel together. Kit, when can the hall receive them, and what’s the latest arrival that works for the makers? Alex, what can you book from 09:15 onward, and what would it cost? Ellis, please confirm the budget and who can approve the quote today.

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text: I can approve up to 102 crowns, including all fees, for all ten bundles to travel together. Lee, when and where can the carrier collect them? Kit, when can assembly hall receive them, and what’s the latest arrival that works for the session? Alex, please quote the full load and confirm pickup and delivery times so I can approve the booking.

turns.speaker: Kit
turns.text: I can have someone at assembly hall to receive all ten bundles together, with 11:00 today as the latest staffed handover. We can’t accept an unattended drop. Lee, when will the load be ready? Alex, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by 11:00? Ellis, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
I can book one truck for all ten bundles. Today’s fixed pickup times, guaranteed staffed handover deadlines, and all-in prices are:

- V237 picks up at 09:12, hands over by 10:15, and costs 67 crowns.
- V465 picks up at 09:25, hands over by 10:54, and costs 54 crowns.
- V176 picks up at 09:35, hands over by 10:24, and costs 83 crowns.
- V499 picks up at 09:39, hands over by 10:21, and costs 117 crowns.

Lee, when can all ten bundles be ready? Kit, what’s your staffed receiving window at the hall? Ellis, what spend can you authorize? Once you confirm, I can book the cheapest service that fits.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
I’m tendering V465 for all ten bundles. It picks up at 09:25 and guarantees staffed handover at assembly hall by 10:54 for 54 crowns all in. It saves 29 crowns over V176, with six minutes to spare before the 11:00 cutoff.

Lee, please confirm the pickup address and that all ten bundles will be ready at 09:25. Kit, please confirm staffed coverage for the handover. Ellis, please approve the 54 crowns. If any of you can’t commit, please say what would prevent the booking.

[PROPOSE: V465]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
All ten bundles will be ready for pickup together at 09:25. I’ll confirm the pickup address separately.

[APPROVE: V465]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I authorize 54 crowns all in for V465 to carry all ten bundles together. The 09:25 pickup gives Lee ten minutes after the load is ready, and the guaranteed 10:54 handover meets Kit’s 11:00 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V465]

turns.speaker: Kit
turns.text:
Our crew was reassigned, so 10:30 is now the latest staffed handover. V465 only guarantees delivery by 10:54, and we can’t accept an unattended drop. Alex, please tender V176. Its 09:35 pickup works for Lee, I can receive all ten bundles by 10:24, and 83 crowns is within budget.

[HOLD: V465]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
I’m requesting V176 for all ten bundles together. It picks up at 09:35 and guarantees staffed handover at assembly hall by 10:24, six minutes before Kit’s revised 10:30 cutoff. It costs 83 crowns all in, 29 more than V465 and within budget.

Lee, please confirm the 09:35 pickup and send the address. Kit, please ratify staffed receipt for V176. Ellis, please authorize the 83 crowns. I’ll release the booking once all three of you ratify it.

[BOOK: V176]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I can release all ten bundles together for the 09:35 pickup. The pickup address still needs confirmation.

[APPROVE: V176]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I authorize 83 crowns all in for V176 to carry all ten bundles together. It’s within my 102-crown limit, and the guaranteed handover by 10:24 meets Kit’s revised 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V176]

turns.speaker: Kit
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at assembly hall to receive all ten bundles together. V176 guarantees handover by 10:24, before our 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V176]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text: I can release all ten bundles of reusable lantern frames for pickup at 09:15 at the earliest. They’re packed and need to travel together in one load. Kit, when can the assembly hall receive them, and what’s the latest arrival that works for the makers’ session? Alex, can you find a carrier that fits that window and share the quote? Ellis, what budget can we book against?

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text: Lee, when will all ten bundles be ready for pickup? Kit, what delivery window works for assembly hall ahead of the makers’ session? Alex, please quote a service that can carry all ten together today and confirm pickup and delivery times. I can authorize up to 102 crowns including all fees.

turns.speaker: Kit
turns.text: I can guarantee a staffed handover at assembly hall through 11:00, including at 11:00. All ten bundles need to arrive together, and someone must be there to receive them. Lee, when can the full load be ready? Alex, what can you book to meet that cutoff, and at what price? Ellis, can you confirm what we can spend?

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
I can book all ten bundles together. Today’s quotes, with pickup first, guaranteed staffed handover time second and the all-in price in crowns, are V465 (09:25, 10:54, 54), V237 (09:12, 10:15, 67), V176 (09:35, 10:24, 83) and V499 (09:39, 10:21, 117).

Lee, when will all ten be ready? Kit, what handover window can you staff in time for the session? Ellis, what spend can you approve? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits once you confirm.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
I’m tendering V465 at 54 crowns all in. Pickup is at 09:25, ten minutes after the load is ready. Staffed handover is guaranteed by 10:54, six minutes before Kit’s cutoff. V176 would buy another 30 minutes of margin for 29 crowns more.

Lee, please commit all ten bundles for the 09:25 pickup. Kit, please confirm coverage through 10:54. Ellis, please authorize the 54 crowns. If anyone sees a blocker, please flag it before I book.

[PROPOSE: V465]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I can release all ten bundles together for the 09:25 pickup. The full load will be ready at 09:15.

[APPROVE: V465]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I authorize 54 crowns all in for V465. It’s the lowest quote that gets all ten bundles to assembly hall together within Kit’s receiving window.

[APPROVE: V465]

turns.speaker: Kit
turns.text:
Our crew has been reassigned, so 10:30 is now the last staffed handover. We can’t accept an unattended drop. Please switch to V176. I can cover its 10:24 handover.

[HOLD: V465]

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text:
I’m requesting V176 for all ten bundles together. Its 09:35 pickup works with Lee’s 09:15 ready time, and Kit can staff the guaranteed handover by 10:24. V465 misses the revised 10:30 cutoff. V176 costs 83 crowns all in, within Ellis’s 102-crown limit.

Lee, Kit and Ellis, please ratify V176 for pickup, staffed receipt and payment.

[BOOK: V176]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I commit all ten bundles together for V176. The full load will be ready at 09:15 for the 09:35 pickup.

[APPROVE: V176]

turns.speaker: Ellis
turns.text:
I authorize 83 crowns all in for V176. It’s within our 102-crown limit and gets all ten bundles to Kit by 10:24, before the revised 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V176]

turns.speaker: Kit
turns.text:
I confirm staffed receipt of all ten bundles at assembly hall. The 10:24 handover is within our 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V176]
